cues.text: Let's update the fees for a class.
Open Finance, then Fee Setup. The Monthly Structure tab shows the monthly fee of each class.
Choose By Class, then press Edit on the class you want to change.
Change the amount for the fee category. You can add or remove charges here too.
Press Review and Save to check the new total before it's saved.
Press Confirm and Save. Fee records you generate later will use this amount.
